methodology: 72 distinct internally authored prose cases frozen before first execution at application commit 2db3b36. Includes explicit duties, shared and unknown ownership, definite-article and passive dependencies, causal and missing rationales, denials, historical and unsupported activity. Labels were authored by the implementing agent with knowledge of prior patterns; this is not independent human or enterprise ground truth. Preserve the first report; any fixes make this corpus regression data.
